shortDescription: Manages BIG-IP SNMP data collecting agent (DCA) monitors

options.name: agent_type
options.description: Specifies the SNMP agent running on the monitored server. When creating a new monitor, the default is C(UCD) (UC-Davis).

options.name: community
options.description: Specifies the community name the system must use to authenticate with the host server through SNMP. When creating a new monitor, the default value is C(public). This value is case sensitive.

options.name: cpu_coefficient
options.description: Specifies the coefficient the system uses to calculate the weight of the CPU threshold in the dynamic ratio load balancing algorithm. When creating a new monitor, the default is C(1.5).

options.name: cpu_threshold
options.description: Specifies the maximum acceptable CPU usage on the target server. When creating a new monitor, the default is C(80) percent.

options.name: description
options.description: Specifies descriptive text that identifies the monitor.

options.name: disk_coefficient
options.description: Specifies the coefficient the system uses to calculate the weight of the disk threshold in the dynamic ratio load balancing algorithm. When creating a new monitor, the default is C(2.0).

options.name: disk_threshold
options.description: Specifies the maximum acceptable disk usage on the target server. When creating a new monitor, the default is C(90) percent.

options.name: interval
options.description: Specifies the frequency, in seconds, at which the system issues the monitor check when either the resource is down or the status of the resource is unknown. When creating a new monitor, the default is C(10).

options.name: memory_coefficient
options.description: Specifies the coefficient the system uses to calculate the weight of the memory threshold in the dynamic ratio load balancing algorithm. When creating a new monitor, the default is C(1.0).

options.name: memory_threshold
options.description: Specifies the maximum acceptable memory usage on the target server. When creating a new monitor, the default is C(70) percent.

options.name: parent
options.description: The parent template of this monitor template. Once this value has been set, it cannot be changed. By default, this value is the C(snmp_dca) parent on the C(Common) partition.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the monitor exists. When C(absent), ensures the monitor is removed.

options.name: time_until_up
options.description: Specifies the number of seconds to wait after a resource first responds correctly to the monitor before setting the resource to 'up'. During the interval, all responses from the resource must be correct. When the interval expires, the resource is marked 'up'. A value of 0, means that the resource is marked up immediately upon receipt of the first correct response. When creating a new monitor, the default is C(0).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Specifies the number of seconds the target has in which to respond to the monitor request. When creating a new monitor, the default is C(30) seconds. If the target responds within the set time period, it is considered 'up'. If the target does not respond within the set time period, it is considered 'down'. When this value is set to 0 (zero), the system uses the interval from the parent monitor. Note that C(timeout) and C(time_until_up) combine to control when a resource is set to up.

options.name: version
options.description: Specifies the version of SNMP the host server uses. When creating a new monitor, the default is C(v1). When C(v1), specifies the host server uses SNMP version 1. When C(v2c), specifies that the host server uses SNMP version 2c.
